args.body: Take WELFARE-READINESS-PUBLICATION. Existing research is finished: make its useful verified findings accessible to providers instead of repeating failed portal fetches. Prepare the small supplement and exact-digest review handoff; do not deploy or expand the offer. Read original evidence yourself and correct ambiguous language in the saved note, especially suitability versus eligibility and unknown registration requirements. No additional CSV or unlisted Actor work. Publication is an offer improvement, not evidence of acquisition or revenue.

description: No new classified commercial feedback is available; three sources remain unclassified. The tender-document fetches failed, so mandatory qualifications remain unknown. Make the existing verified readiness note publicly useful through a reviewed supplement, while preserving both live observation windows. Funding and revenue remain unverified.
